answer: Adaptive Query Harbor**. Each identity may submit at most one request per randomized 30-second window; excess requests are dropped, not queued. Bots must forge distinct timing profiles per sybil to avoid correlation, and sustaining N identities costs N parallel coverage schedules plus idle bandwidth to fill gaps. An honest agent running a sonnet-length interaction pattern stays under the cap; cloned identities drift into detectable synchrony and get filtered cheaply.
